- ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW ranked 2 TW at £2,982.60 (8.3% share), down 11.4% WoW from £3,365.07 LW on 144 units TW versus 171 LW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £2,511.24 TW across 200 units and 41 orders, versus £0.00 and 0 orders LW, so no WoW percentage is calculable.
- The four paper party SKUs (SET/6 WOODLAND PAPER PLATES £1,317.70, WOODLAND PAPER CUPS £1,301.70, STRAWBERRY PAPER CUPS £1,296.00, STRAWBERRY PAPER PLATES £1,249.66) totalled £5,165.06 TW, 14.3% of TW revenue, on 51,203 units TW versus 42 units LW.
- Seven door mat lines combined for £7,842.55 TW, 21.5% of TW revenue, led by DOOR MAT SPOTTY HOME SWEET HOME at £1,333.70 (up 328.3% WoW) and DOOR MAT HEARTS at £1,206.37 (up 782.7% WoW).
- Only four rows fell WoW: ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT £1,014.63 (-29.8%), JUMBO BAG RED WHITE SPOTTY £1,053.89 (-24.9%), PARTY BUNTING £1,014.34 (-12.0%) and ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW (-11.4%).
- PINK CHERRY LIGHTS £1,053.75 (+77.1% WoW) and WHITE CHERRY LIGHTS £1,020.81 (+95.4% WoW) ranked 16 and 19 TW, with orders up to 11 and 20 TW from 8 and 12 LW.
- BATHROOM SET LOVE HEART DESIGN recorded £972.00 TW on 432 units in 1 order, against £0.00 LW; LY revenue is blank for all 28 rows, so YoY cannot be computed for ISO week 2010-W11.
